_comment: Sidecar config copied next to a voice as <VoiceName>.json. All fields optional. Tensor names are auto-resolved at load time: the configured name wins, then known aliases (sid/ds, phone_length/phone_lengths), and length inputs that an export does not declare are skipped - so both the official 5-input RVC export and 7-input exports load without edits. Only set these if your export uses truly unusual names (inspect with Netron).
